description: The only known surviving Vultee V-1AD; custom built in 1936 for the publisher William Randolph Hearst Sr; year_built from the museum's own statement of build year not from a serial

Previously owned and restored by the pilot Ron Alexander; museum describes it as the Shannon Air Express a 1940 airliner originally sold to Braniff International Airways; no registration published on the museum site

First of the Mailwing series designed to carry air mail and cargo; ownership is unclear - the Science Museum of Virginia is recorded as owner of a PA-5 Mailwing returned to it when the Virginia Aviation Museum closed in 2016 so this is very likely that airframe on loan
No registration published on the museum site
Powered by a Wright J-6 radial of 165 hp with seating for a pilot and two passengers; no registration published
